conversion: Deposited Activity values unchanged; no new IC50/Ki conversion or imputation.
assay_comparability: Historical benchmark endpoint; not independently assay-adjudicated
reference_policy: Fewest heavy atoms, ID tie-break, independent of activities. A smaller fixed reference bounds the MCS QC search; no supplied coordinates are realigned.
attribution: Aher et al. (2007); aligned data deposited by Haga et al. (2025), clhaga/pycomsia.
selection: All 63 original training and 12 original test records; none removed by potency or prediction.
tutorial_split: New default seed-42 random 56/19 split of the full public cohort; not the historical 63/12 partition.
preparation: Existing neutral-parent standardisation, no canonical tautomer pass; heavy-atom elements, bonds and coordinates verified unchanged by atom provenance. Source protonation/redundant stereo representation changes recorded per compound. Hydrogens regenerated by normal field preparation. No measured activity changed.
coordinate_assumption: Publisher-deposited pre-alignment; not crystallographic binding poses or a validated protonation state.
